adapter.name: b0
adapter.description: Today's lookups, each called with the question as its query: MemoryStore.recall (a substring match on the whole question), DocumentStore.search (top 3) and, only for a case with an attached meeting, Phase 43 relevant_lines. Notes, tasks and reminders have no free-form lookup today, and an unattached meeting is not searched. Source order is fixed (documents, memories, meeting); within a source, the store's own order.

embedder_note: deterministic bag-of-words stand-in; document scores are lexical, not sentence-transformers scores
digest_covers: hits, ranks, scores, leaks and probe outcomes; not timings or the environment

read_side_effects.note: MemoryStore.recall writes last_accessed on every read; the store fingerprint excludes it. A retrieval path that must be read-only (shadow mode) needs a read that does not stamp.
